reason: scope:IMS-MDA: The grouped drawing supports the common MDA amplification core. The Seth-Smith abstract establishes immunomagnetic target-bacterial enrichment upstream of whole-genome amplification and sequencing, without establishing a single-cell compartment, exclusive purity, exact primer end chemistry, or the drawn S1 treatment. The generic s_genome boundary does not assert that IMS has already been drawn or that MIDAS microwell history applies to IMS-MDA. Applicability of o_s1 to this implementation remains unverified. Its downstream sequencing readout addresses genomes of the target-enriched bacterial population, not a guaranteed single bacterium or perfectly pure target DNA. The enrichment label establishes selection intent, not perfect specificity.

candidate.scope: The assigned middle row is a grouped schematic of genome-directed multiple displacement amplification, with IMS-MDA and MIDAS named as distinct implementations. Paper evidence qualifies the upstream enrichment/compartment interfaces and the MIDAS product-conversion discrepancy.

Products from individual wells are extracted separately; the common row does not depict pooling. o_s1 is retained as the drawing’s family-level route but is not assigned to this primary implementation: DNA polymerase I plus random hexamers and Ampligase convert its hyperbranched products to linear double-stranded DNA before transposase-based library construction. research_questions.question: The grouped drawing supports the common MDA amplification core. The Seth-Smith abstract establishes immunomagnetic target-bacterial enrichment upstream of whole-genome amplification and sequencing, without establishing a single-cell compartment, exclusive purity, exact primer end chemistry, or the drawn S1 treatment. The generic s_genome boundary does not assert that IMS has already been drawn or that MIDAS microwell history applies to IMS-MDA. Applicability of o_s1 to this implementation remains unverified. Its downstream sequencing readout addresses genomes of the target-enriched bacterial population, not a guaranteed single bacterium or perfectly pure target DNA. The enrichment label establishes selection intent, not perfect specificity.
